reviews.text: Caleb and his team did an amazing job with our pool renovation. He was very patient and answered all my questions. He was very quick and ready to start soon after I had some other contractor work done on the house. He came to help us pick out tile and showed us photos of jobs he's done before with each type of tile and pool finish. We ended up with the MiniPebble with Costa rica in aqua white, and upgraded all the equipment. Really happy with the work and customer service! Highly recommend..

I cannot speak highly enough about Bula Pools and the professional pride that Caleb puts into his business. I vetted a total of 9 pool companies for my pool resurface/ deck overlay remodel and Bula Pools quickly and clear rose to the top. Caleb now only comes out to discuss the project in person, he educated me on how things are done correctly, common short cuts to avoid, and the nuances of the actual process. He proposal was very competitively priced to my current pool maintenance guy with many
